newsitem.title: USA: Vulcan Materials buys Block Rock Quarries.
newsitem.headline: Vulcan Materials buys Block Rock Quarries.

text.p: Vulcan Materials Co said on Friday that it bought substantially all of the assets of Black Rock Quarries Inc.
The terms were not disclosed. Black Rock Quarries, an Arkansas-based company, operates a quarry and stone-crushing plant near Black Rock, Ark.
The transaction would provide Vulcan Materials with an initial presence in the Arkansas industry, the company said.
Vulcan, which is based in Birmingham, Ala., produces industrial materials and commodities with significant positions in two industries.
